elements.label: Slack and Notion icon tiles (sequential grey flash)
Google Drive tile right edge (residual flash at burst start)

pattern.description: In the tight crop of the connector tray, tiles flash to a darkened grey state one at a time for a frame or two (Slack at f145, Notion at f154), then snap back, continuing the left-to-right flash run from earlier events.
pattern.why_premium: Each flash lands on a music transient, so the static logo row pulses in rhythm and the eye is walked across each integration without any layout motion or extra graphics.

build_hint.gsap: For each tile in order, `.set(tile, {filter: 'brightness(0.55) saturate(0.6)'}, beatTime)` then `.set(tile, {filter: 'none'}, beatTime + 0.067)`; no tween or ease, beat-spaced (about 0.27 s here) rather than a fixed stagger.
build_hint.remotion: Per tile index i, `const on = frame >= beatFrames[i] && frame < beatFrames[i] + 2;` and `filter: on ? 'brightness(0.55)' : 'none'` with no interpolate; beatFrames from the music beat list.

notes: b02 is a union box spanning both Slack and Notion, which flash at different frames; kept as one element rather than inventing boxes. b01 is a thin sliver at the Drive tile's right edge; the f143 filmstrip crop shows a grey tile edge there, but it is unclear whether Drive flashed or this is a crop or encode artefact. Part of a recurring run with e002 and e004.
